name: SPRITZER
recent: Spritzer 近期的主要动态是董事与大股东（包括执行董事 Lam Sang 及 Lim 家族相关人士）在公开市场买卖公司股份，其中 9 月 4 日有一笔 500 万股的大额脱售。此外，公司品牌与营销活动持续曝光，Spritzer Sparkling 推出新广告活动，并在 World Branding Awards 中获奖。
notable: 执行董事 Lam Sang 在 9 月至 10 月间多次在公开市场买卖公司股份，包括 9 月 9 日及 10 日合计脱售约 25.4 万股。
包括主席 Dato' Seri Lim A Heng 在内的多名董事及大股东，于 9 月 4 日以每股 RM3.60 脱售合计 500 万股（占 0.781%）的间接权益股份。
Spritzer Sparkling 推出「Rasa Light Je」新广告活动，品牌在 2026–2027 World Branding Awards 中获选为「Brand of the Year」之一。
risks: 执行董事 Lam Sang 在 9 月多次于公开市场脱售股份。
主席及多名董事与大股东于 9 月 4 日合计脱售 500 万股间接权益股份。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度，营收为 MYR 202.98 million，环比增长 28.5%，同比增长 23.5%；净利为 MYR 35.35 million，环比增长 58.2%，同比增长 55.6%；净利率由上一季的 14.1% 升至 17.4%。

recent_en: Spritzer's recent activity has mainly been directors' and major shareholders' open-market dealings in the shares, including a block disposal of 5 million shares on 4 September. Meanwhile, the brand has kept up marketing exposure, with Spritzer Sparkling launching a new campaign and winning at the World Branding Awards.
notable_en: Executive Director Lam Sang traded the shares on the open market several times between September and October, including disposing of about 254,000 shares on 9–10 September and acquiring 30,000 shares on 13 October.
Several directors and major shareholders, including Chairman Dato' Seri Lim A Heng, disposed of a combined 5 million shares (0.781%) of deemed interest at RM3.60 each on 4 September.
Spritzer Sparkling launched its new 'Rasa Light Je' campaign, and the brand was named one of the 'Brand of the Year' winners at the 2026–2027 World Branding Awards.
risks_en: Executive Director Lam Sang disposed of shares on the open market several times in September.
The Chairman and several directors and major shareholders collectively disposed of 5 million shares of deemed interest on 4 September.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 202.98 million, up 28.5% QoQ and 23.5% YoY; net income was MYR 35.35 million, up 58.2% QoQ and 55.6% YoY; net margin rose to 17.4% from 14.1% in the previous quarter.
